picks.thesis: Q3 adjusted EBITDA $612M beat its own $575M guide (best quarter in three years), adj. EPS $0.28 vs $0.22 est., Q4 EBITDA guided up to ~$715M, and management says the 2027 outlook (>$4B EBITDA) 'improved materially': an estimate-raising print from the 8-K, not a one-day headline. The gap is big (+14% premarket to ~$13.83) and revenue missed slightly, so conviction 1 and confirm_vwap: buy only if the gap holds above VWAP. Wrong if it fades below ~$13.00 (half the gap), which the 7% stop roughly enforces, or closes below VWAP on day one.
